plugins.name: glm-roles
plugins.description: Role-based model routing for GLM: deep tasks go to GLM-5.3, quick tasks to GLM-5.3-Flash, via role subagents, commands and an auto-routing skill.

description_i18n.en: Route subtasks by role: deep tasks to GLM-5.3, quick tasks to GLM-5.3-Flash. Models are freely assignable across plans.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把子任务按角色分流：深度任务走 GLM-5.3，轻量任务走 GLM-5.3-Flash；角色模型可跨套餐自由指派。
